entries.3c25b64a1dea4b9e: Customers such as families, office workers and students
entries.3f4532fb0b72b15e: Formats other than Za Meshiya, Machikadoya, Sanuki Seimen and Meshiya Shokudo. The number of stores is 2, and sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥260 million.
entries.939b7e3972161744: A single-segment business operating a chain of restaurants centered on Japanese cuisine. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥9,614 million, and the number of stores at the end of the period was 88. It operates stores in 2 fu and 6 ken: the Kansai area (Osaka, Hyogo, Kyoto and Nara prefectures), the Chubu area (Aichi, Mie and Gifu prefectures), and the Chugoku area (Okayama Prefecture).
entries.a7019a89f4748b9a: A specialty shop serving udon noodles made daily in an in-store noodle-making facility using the Sanuki method, with carefully selected wheat and salt. It also offers omusubi, tempura and oden. The number of stores is 12, and sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥1,109 million.
entries.aa23284cd506b3b4: Japanese menu items centered on home cooking
entries.bd00c7c27ec48bf2: A cafeteria-style format offering about 120 menu items centered on home cooking, allowing customers to freely combine dishes. It combines elements of both a fast-food format with short waiting times and a relaxed restaurant type. The number of stores is 26, and sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥3,347 million.
entries.db0021c3da260346: Operates a chain of restaurants centered on Japanese cuisine in the Kansai, Chubu, and Chugoku regions.
entries.ec6c977222cd3db0: A Japanese-style set meal restaurant of the fast-food type that narrows its menu to rice bowls and set meals and cooks to order. It targets a broad customer base, including families, office workers and students, with its “reassuring low prices” and bright store design. The number of stores is 41, and sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥4,243 million.
entries.f167833301dcac8d: A smaller cafeteria-style format that applies know-how from Za Meshiya. It aims to diversify store locations by keeping initial investment low and operating efficiently with a small staff. The number of stores is 7, and sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥654 million.
